params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Get the status of a long-running OneNote operation. This applies to operations that return the Operation-Location header in the response, such as CopyNotebook, CopyToNotebook, CopyToSectionGroup, and CopyToSection. info.name: Microsoft Graph Create onenotePage

items.docs: Create a new OneNote page in the default section of the default notebook. To create a page in a different section in the default notebook, you can use the sectionName query parameter.  Example: ../onenote/pages?sectionName=My%20section The POST /onenote/pages operation is used only to create pages in the current user's default notebook. If you're targeting other notebooks, you can create pages in a specified section.
